notes: Posted 9 August 2001 with Coruscant-set cards (P-59, P-60), so the format is Premiere - Coruscant.

Starting (7) as posted: Agents Of Black Sun ('AOBS'), Coruscant: Imperial City, Coruscant, Start Your Engines! ('Star Your Engines'), Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Boonta Eve Podrace and Sebulba's Podracer ('Subulba's Pod Racer'); these count toward the total.

The list totals 59 as published: the Effects header says (11) but only 10 Effects are listed. Kept as published. The strategy adds that the author forgot one more Twi'lek Advisor and meant No Escape instead of Crush The Rebellion; the list is kept as posted.

Section headers ('Agents Of Black Sun', 'Starting', 'Locations', 'Characters', 'Star Ships', 'Vehicles', 'Effects', 'Interrupts') are not cards; 'Agents Of Black Sun' above the Starting header repeats the objective and is not counted again.
Posted 'Coruscant' dested the Dark Special Edition system Coruscant (Dark) (Special Edition), the system Agents Of Black Sun deploys with Imperial City.
Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Boonta Eve Podrace, Hoth: Echo Command Center (War Room) ('Hoth War Room') and Spaceport Docking Bay ('Space Port Docking Bay') dested to their Dark pages.
Posted 'Death Star II War room' dested Death Star: War Room (there is no Death Star II war room site); 'Throne Room' Death Star II: Throne Room; 'Wampa Cave' Hoth: Wampa Cave (7th Marker).

Posted '4-lom w/gun' dested 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle; 'Fett w/ gun' Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle; 'I-G w/gun' IG-88 With Riot Gun; 'Dengar w/gun' Dengar With Blaster Carbine; 'Palpy' Emperor Palpatine; 'Xixor' Prince Xizor; 'Aurara Sing' Aurra Sing; 'Dans Borenz' Danz Borin.
Posted 'Zuckus w/gun' is printed as written: there was no Zuckuss-with-weapon character in Decipher's sets (Zuckuss With Snare Rifle is a later virtual card).
Posted 'I-G in I-G 2000' dested IG-88 In IG-2000; 'Fett in Slave One' Boba Fett In Slave I; 'Zuckus in Mist Hunter' Zuckuss In Mist Hunter.
Posted 'AT-AT x 2' dested Blizzard Walker, the generic Hoth AT-AT (the strategy: 'You have some at-ats').

Posted 'Opp reinforcement/there is not try' dested There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement; 'Twillek Advisor' Twi'lek Advisor; 'Control/set for stun' Control & Set For Stun; 'Pod Racer Collision' Podracer Collision; 'Omni box/its worse' Ommni Box & It's Worse.
